Do Sauna Blankets Work?

A sauna blanket will heat you up and make you sweat, so it can feel like a sauna. But we found no published trials testing sauna blankets themselves. The health findings people quote come from traditional Finnish saunas used for years, and a 2018 systematic review of dry sauna studies called the benefits potential, with mostly small studies. Weight lost in a blanket is water, and it comes back when you drink.

Swipe for the details. The full guide, with every source linked, is at the link in bio.
